reason: ₹22,000 is almost a whole month of what our house earns, and hand-washing costs nothing. Even if I wanted a machine, I would not buy it in an ordinary week; I would wait for Diwali and see what offer the dealer gives.
objection: The pump only runs when there is power, so when the light goes I have no water anyway. What good is a battery that finishes the wash if the tank is empty? And ₹1,999 every month for a year is a big weight for something we already do by hand.
would_change_my_mind: A proper Diwali offer from the local dealer: a good discount or a free gift with low-cost EMI, so the monthly amount comes down to around ₹1,200 and I can see a neighbour's machine working through power cuts.
